commits.subject: feat(api): add integration credential lifecycle
commits.description: Prepare Arbiter to issue independently revocable, read-only member-directory credentials for staff-managed integrations using the future standalone API. Secrets are shown once, verified without recoverable storage, and can expire or be revoked; archiving an integration disables all of its credentials. This is a behind-the-scenes database and service capability, so no Discord command, portal, or public API route changes yet.
